name: Semantic Web Services Challenge (Year 1)
description: An introduction and summary of the inaugural Semantic Web Services Challenge, describing tasks, datasets, and evaluation metrics for the community.
reputation: An influential, early benchmark within the semantic web research community but relatively niche outside that field.
notes: Non-LLM / classical semantic-web evaluation; datasets and tasks are domain-specific and older, often relatively small and tailored to service discovery/annotation problems.
